==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode== 
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I am playfully chased by a lovestruck elven woman in the park. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The lovestruck elf woman was wearing a long pink dress with a white doily collar. She had long brown hair tied back into a ponytail with a pink hair tie.) A sink hole opens beneath us and we fall into an underground tunnel full of golden trees. The orc defenders of the trees attack us with scimitars, but we both escape using Geo-Man suits. (I was surprised to discover that the woman obsessing over me was a fellow geomancer.) (Geo-Man suits resemble sleek, form fitting, armored suit made of black stone tiles.)
